verdict.rationale: Clerk exposes a public Backend API: a probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at clerk.com/openapi.json, and the migration docs describe an open-source tool that creates users through the Backend API within its rate limits. The pricing page lists "APIs and prebuilt UIs," and API keys and OAuth scoped access let programmatic callers and third-party apps use the API. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party Backend API reference content (endpoint coverage, auth and rate-limit details) in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
